preview_heading: Falcons meet Knight Riders in North Sound
preview: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons face Trinbago Knight Riders in CPL 2026 Match 14 at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium. The match is scheduled for Sat 22 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo. The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
